supported_statement: Within the documented sample, the observed squads under different Sporting Directors differed materially on all four locked profile variables (median squad age ranged 22.3751-28.3915 years; observed under-23 share 0.1667-0.5455).
allowed_wording: Within the documented sample, the observed squads under X were younger than those under Y.
forbidden_wording: X prefers young players / X's intrinsic style is youth-oriented / these are director types.
main_limitation: 16 of 60 club-seasons; rows are not independent.

supported_statement: Within the documented sample, the spread between directors' observed medians exceeded the median within-director range on all four locked variables.
allowed_wording: Observed squads under some directors were consistently older across multiple documented seasons.
forbidden_wording: Director X has an intrinsic preference for older players.
main_limitation: Only 4 of 8 directors have repeated seasons and only 2 of those changed club, so consistency is confounded with remaining at the same club.

supported_statement: Four of the eight directors in the director-level sample are documented for a single season.
allowed_wording: Across X's observed seasons... (with n_seasons and n_clubs stated).
forbidden_wording: A one-season director's summary is a profile.
main_limitation: Half the director summaries rest on one squad.

supported_statement: Within the documented sample, the observed under-23 share and the club's within-season squad-value percentile moved together (Spearman rho = +0.5355, N = 16, predeclared band MODERATE).
allowed_wording: Within the documented sample, u23_share is positively associated with club-value percentile (descriptive association).
forbidden_wording: Sporting Directors at richer clubs prefer youth / club wealth causes youth recruitment / u23 share predicts club value.
main_limitation: Descriptive association only; no test, no p-value, no fitted line; the high-value end holds only the 2 co-managed Barcelona rows.

supported_statement: For age_30plus_share the spread of season medians was 1.8815x the full-sample IQR.
allowed_wording: An apparent difference between directors on the 30-plus share may reflect the season in which they were observed.
forbidden_wording: The league got younger over time / there is a trend in squad ageing.
main_limitation: Three seasons cannot support a trend; this is a caution, not a time series.

supported_statement: In the only 2 documented cross-club cases (Antonio Cordon; Victor Orta), the second club's observed squad was younger on median age and higher on under-23 share.
allowed_wording: Case evidence suggests... (naming both the club change and the season change).
forbidden_wording: Operating style travels with the director / a director effect / adaptation / style persistence.
main_limitation: Club change, season change and club resource level are collinear in both cases; n = 2.

supported_statement: The director-level behavioural sample contains 0 rows from clubs in the highest within-season squad-value quartile.
allowed_wording: No statement in this work applies to Spain's wealthiest clubs.
forbidden_wording: This represents La Liga / these are league-wide patterns.
main_limitation: Both Q4 rows are one co-managed Barcelona club-season, excluded from director summaries.

supported_statement: Restricting to GREEN-quality rows shifted the sample medians by at most 0.06 years or 0.011 proportion and preserved the rank ordering of the retained directors on all four variables.
allowed_wording: The descriptive picture is robust to documentation quality within the documented sample.
forbidden_wording: The findings are validated / confirmed / replicated.
main_limitation: GREEN-only retains 5 of 8 directors and ZERO multi-club directors, so it is diagnostic only.

supported_statement: No causal estimand exists anywhere in the V2 cycle; no effect is identified and no counterfactual is defined.
allowed_wording: Associated with / co-occurs with / historically observed alongside.
forbidden_wording: Causes / drives / explains / leads to / results in.
main_limitation: Season-level incumbency is documented exposure, not established decision authority.

supported_statement: No model was developed, fitted or evaluated at any point in the V2 cycle; Stages 5, 6 and 7 were skipped on scientific grounds.
allowed_wording: The sample cannot support a defensible model, so none was built.
forbidden_wording: Our model shows / we predict / out-of-sample performance.
main_limitation: Nothing in this work has out-of-sample support.
